description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface, facilitating the registration of a state storage log consistency provider within the Orleans hosting environment. It includes methods to add default and named providers, configuring service dependencies accordingly.

classes.name: StateStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add state storage log consistency providers.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a default state storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a named state storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider (internal)
methods.description: Registers the state storage based log consistency provider in the service collection, setting up necessary dependencies.
